title: fix(ui): Enter in a new chat silently does nothing while the session setup is still loading
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: in a new chat, pressing Enter (or Start) in the first moments after the composer appears can do nothing at all — the text stays in the box, the Start button still looks enabled, and no message, error, or explanation appears — while the page is still restoring the last session setup or refreshing agent defaults.

## User Impact

User impact: while a new chat is not ready to start, the Start button is visibly disabled; if you press Enter or Start (or paste and press Enter) during that moment, the reason appears below the composer ("Restoring your last session setup…" or "Refreshing agent defaults…") and stays until the chat is ready. The text stays editable, and Enter or Start then sends it. Opening a new chat without trying to send shows no notice and no layout shift. A submit attempt never silently disappears.

## Why This Change Was Made

The new-session submit owner already rejects a start while agent defaults or saved model preferences are being prepared, but its explanation was bound to the single rejected attempt and vanished as soon as that gate changed or cleared, and the composer exempted reasoned gates from native disabling, so Start kept its enabled look. Start now uses native disabling with the existing muted style for as long as a gate applies. A submit attempt during that window records that feedback is owed; the composer then shows the current gate's reason (following gate changes) until readiness, below and aligned with the composer but outside its measured box, so the composer does not move. The command palette keeps readiness out of its creation-error channel. The attempt-bound tracker, its terminal notification callback, and the special blocked-button styling are removed. No queueing, protocol, config, persistence, or cancellation change.

## Evidence

- Live, real Gateway with a built-in and a Codex agent: opening a new chat and pressing Enter immediately after the composer appeared dropped the message 4 of 4 times on `main` with no explanation in 3 of 4 and an enabled-looking Start in 2 of 4; with this change all 4 showed the reason ("Restoring your last session setup…" / "Refreshing agent defaults…") with Start disabled, and the next Enter sent each message. Earlier timing probe on `main`: the Codex agent dropped Enter at 0 ms and 300 ms after the composer appeared and accepted it from 600 ms.
- Browser regression (`ui/src/e2e/new-session-page.early-submit.e2e.test.ts`, mocked Gateway holding `agents.list` / `models.list`): real composer, native paste+Enter and Start click during the blocked window; checks the visible reason, preserved text, zero accidental sessions, then exactly one creation with the exact message after release. Fails on the original production code (no explanation), passes with the fix; together with the new-session draft-handoff, config/startup and model-catalog e2e files and the palette cases, 24 browser cases pass (51 across the broader UI e2e run). Unit: 222 passed across the composer, submit gates, native terminal start, command palette, and submission flow. The prior-production control fails all four early-submit cases.
- `pnpm tsgo:ui`, oxlint, stylelint, oxfmt, `git diff --check` pass. Autoreview (Codex): scoped-clean, no actionable findings.
- Review/CI follow-ups: an always-visible notice shifted the composer on every open (model-catalog layout e2e) and leaked into the palette error channel; the notice is now attempt-triggered, aligned, and outside the measured composer, and the layout e2e passes unchanged.

Before (mocked Gateway, model restoration pending — Start looks enabled, no explanation):

![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b990361d-6a49-4a49-85d3-57eee1884876)

After (same moment, after an Enter — Start disabled, reason shown until ready):

![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/69b646b9-938f-44a7-9b14-e2ccb5be69e7)

After, mobile width:

![after mobile](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/95402394-f764-4837-b6ae-8311c5bbc9af)

## Exact-head CI attribution

<!-- l106b-ci-attribution -->
CI [run 39904706792, attempt 1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39904706792) on `e18135aa4f34889c08051b62b2a0523071266163` completed with five inherited UI E2E failures. Every other selected job, including `security-fast`, passed. The failed jobs are [checks-ui-e2e (2/9)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39904706792/job/120254382976) and [checks-ui-e2e (7/9)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39904706792/job/120254383166).

- The cloud-workspace full-request diagnostic has a two-alert strict-mode selector failure at `cloud-workspace-conflict.e2e.test.ts:236`. The duplicate-rename case (`concurrent failure: false`) expects zero sidebar errors but receives one at `session-management.rename.e2e.test.ts:185`. Both reproduce in scheduled main [run 39901237962, job 120243338758](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39901237962/job/120243338758); shard labels differ.
- Three dictation cases assert draft text immediately after Stop: running-turn completion, caret insertion, and selection replacement (`browser-dictation-status.e2e.test.ts:161,223`). All three reproduce with identical expected/actual text in a focused local browser run on main `6786b2d7e5c61e5d9dd786d32a305ebcbdf63610` (3 failed, 10 skipped; 41.00 seconds wall). Main commit `71eb77b765ca` changed Stop to await final transcription after the last scheduled baseline. The dictation test and both owner modules are byte-identical between this main proof and the PR's tested merge.

The CI checkout was `0de32ae8127fc9b9369676ad18c4442c03a20c24`, merging main `cb9a3fca37ed1482bf8c44a49eb7175fabffab81` with this PR head. All six inspected failing-test/owner blobs are unchanged by that merge. The native inherited-failure exception retains the exact logs, checkout/tree identity, and passing scoped proof. This is failed CI with attributed baseline failures, not a green-CI claim. No CI rerun or code change was used to chase green.

## Review follow-up: silent-gate retirement

<!-- l106b-silent-gate-repair -->
At `e18135aa4f34889c08051b62b2a0523071266163`, attempted-submit feedback retires when preparation leaves only a silent gate such as an empty draft. Clearing the draft during loading can no longer cause an unsolicited notice on a later disconnection. This changes one production line and adds a 19-line owner-level regression; creation, cancellation, persistence, layout, and explicit retry remain unchanged.

The regression fails on the preceding head with an unexpected connection notice, then passes with the fix. All 80 focused submission/gate/native-start/palette tests pass (14.51 seconds wall time); UI typechecking, targeted lint, formatting, diff checks, and isolated autoreview through P2 pass. The existing screenshots remain applicable. ClawSweeper completed its review of this repaired head with no actionable findings. The exact-head CI failures are attributed above.
